title: Ploeg authenticated operator API v1
description: GET /api/v1/operator/{teams,summary,unsettled-accounts,work-items,work-items/{id},runs,runs/{id},events,route-refusals}, and POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/cancel, which requires execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor, takes no body and withdraws tracker-originated work; repeating it on a withdrawn or settled item changes nothing and reports withdrawn false. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/approve and /reject decide a proposed Work Item a Run created (ADR-0031); both require execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor and take a JSON body {"reason": string}, required for reject. Approve queues the item; reject closes it as done and releases its allotted budget. Any other state answers 409 not_proposed. Bearer consumers have team scope. Collection after is a decimal bigint cursor; limit defaults 50, maximum 200. Work items filter on team, state, needsHuman=true and the tracker identity provider plus externalId, which must be given together and match across every team in scope unless team narrows it. Detail returns the most recent 200 records per collection, with explicit truncation flags. Audit pagination has snapshot consistency and is not a lossless changefeed: IDs are allocated before commit. Unbound events are omitted. Missing costs and unsupported team pause state remain unknown/null. Text is bounded (16384 characters for descriptions/findings, 4096 for summaries/reasons/URLs), recognizable credentials are redacted, URL queries/fragments are removed. Other credential-bearing structural fields are never selected. A recorded cost is an observation, not proof of final gateway settlement. Summary takes window=24h|7d|30d (default 7d): Work Item counts, pending and running Runs and reservedUsd are current; finished, failed and stuck count Runs finished inside the window by outcome, and settledUsd is spend settled inside the window; lastActivityAt is the Team's latest bound audit event. The Run list is newest first by id with limit 1..200 (default 50), filters team, state and outcome, and pages with before=<runId>, returning nextBefore; teams are scoped by the owning Work Item and externalRef is the tracker reference used in trailers, or empty for manual work. Events take order=asc|desc (default asc); order=desc returns newest first, pages with before=<eventId> and returns that cursor as nextCursor, and lastCursor is the newest event id in the page (0 when empty); after with order=desc, or before without it, is rejected. Timestamps in summary and Run list responses are UTC. Unsettled-accounts takes no query parameters and lists, oldest first and at most 200, the finished Runs in scope whose gateway key the block sweep cannot block (account minting, issued or unknown), each with the budget it still holds; totals cover every such Run in scope, also past the 200th. Route refusals (ADR-0038) lists tracker tasks that routing refused and that therefore have no Work Item: it takes no query parameters and answers the newest refusal of each task refused in the last windowDays (14) days, newest first and at most 50, within the consumer's team scope. A task queued or refreshed after its newest refusal is left out. code is stable; a refusal recorded before codes existed answers unclassified with allowedLabels empty, and reason is the sentence Ploeg also commented on the task. allowedLabels are the repo/ labels the matched board rule allows, empty when no rule matched or the reason is target_not_ready. POST /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/requeue restarts a needs_human, stale or awaiting_review Work Item with no open Shift (ADR-0044); it requires execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor. Without a body it restarts from Round 1; a body is a requeueRequest and must carry commandId, and a repeated commandId returns the first result with replayed true. A live, settled, withdrawn or operator-owned item, an expectedState mismatch and a commandId reused with another body answer 409; a fromRound outside the Team's current plan answers 422 round_not_in_plan, and a fromRound past a writing Round when no earlier Shift recorded pr_opened or pr_updated answers 422 nothing_to_review; a pool above the consumer's maxBudgetUsd answers 400 pool_above_limit. Delivery facts (ADR-0079): GET /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/facts answers factsResponse, and 404 when the Work Item is not in the consumer's scope. GET /api/v1/operator/facts answers factsListResponse: the consumer's team-scoped Work Items, newest activityAt first, ties by id. It takes member=<login>, repeatable up to 20 and compared without case, to keep Work Items whose roster names one of them, team, since=<RFC 3339> to keep activityAt at or after it, before=<nextBefore> and limit 1..25 (default 10); nextBefore is an opaque cursor or null. Facts are stored values only: no grade, tier, score, KPI, status kind or working time. PUT /api/v1/operator/work-items/{id}/pull-request-comments/{key} takes a pullRequestCommentRequest and keeps one comment per pull request and key, marked <!-- ploeg:comment:<key> -->, posted with Ploeg's forge credentials; it requires execute permission and X-Ploeg-Actor, answers pullRequestCommentResponse, 404 for a Work Item outside the scope or a pull request it does not have, 409 no_pull_request when it has none, 422 unsafe_svg, 422 adopt_not_found when adoptCommentId names no Ploeg-marked comment, 413 for a body over 384 KiB and 502 forge_unavailable when the forge refused; each write is audited as pull_request_comment.upserted. DELETE on the same path removes that key's comment from every pull request where Ploeg recorded it, audited as pull_request_comment.deleted, and answers pullRequestCommentDeleteResponse. The Run card, card list, crack, evolved and card legacy export routes were removed by ADR-0080 and answer 404.

number.description: The pull request's number. Null when the link names none.

mergeState.description: Whether the pull request merges into its base branch, as the review poll last confirmed it (ADR-0040). conflicted needs two polls in a row at one head that report a conflict; a new head resets it to unknown. unknown until a forge that reports mergeability is polled, and on a forge that does not. It never changes the Work Item's state.

baseBranch.description: The branch the forge said the pull request targets, or the Work Item's target branch when the forge has not said. Null when neither is known.

checkedAt.description: When the review poll last read the merge state. Null until it has; a failed forge read leaves it unchanged.

changesRequestedBy.description: Each distinct forge login that asked for changes on the pull request, ordered by its newest request first. Empty when nobody did.

mergedAt.description: When the forge merged the pull request (ADR-0045). Absent until a webhook or the review poll reports the merge.

mergedBy.description: The forge login that merged the pull request. Absent when unknown.

headSha.description: The newest head commit the forge reported for the pull request. Absent when unknown.

mergeCommitSha.description: The commit the merge produced on the base branch. Absent when unknown or not merged.

reviews.description: Every review the forge reported on the pull request, oldest first, at most the newest 50. Empty when none was recorded.

state.description: Absent when the forge did not classify the review.

headSha.description: The head commit the review was given on. Absent when the forge did not say.

pinnedScopes.description: Tracker container ids (Vikunja project, ClickUp list) pinned to this team: their items run as this team whoever is assigned, and unassigning withdraws this team's item. Sorted; empty when none. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

assignees.description: Tracker usernames, lowercased and sorted, whose assignment routes a Tracker Item to this team (config teams.<team>.assignees and PLOEG_TEAM_MAP). Empty when no username routes to the team. Absent from Ploeg releases that predate the field.

usage.description: A Run's usage as its harness reported it, with the cost Ploeg observed. Every field is absent when unknown; the fields after costUsd are kept since ADR-0045.

problem.description: A writing Run's account of what was wrong or missing (ADR-0042), markdown, at most 4096 characters. Empty for a reading Run and for a writer that reported none.

solution.description: A writing Run's account of what it changed (ADR-0042), markdown, at most 4096 characters. Empty for a reading Run and for a writer that reported none.

settledAt.description: When the Run's gateway account was first settled. Absent before settlement and for a Run without an account.

costFinalAt.description: When the settled cost stops being corrected for late gateway charges: the end of the correction window, or settledAt when the settlement opened none.

costFinal.description: True once the Run's cost will no longer change. A settled cost before costFinalAt is provisional and may rise.

withdrawn.description: True when this request withdrew the item; false when nothing was live.

shiftId.description: The Shift this request closed with close reason withdrawn_by_operator.

cancelledRuns.description: Pending Runs that will not start.

stoppedRuns.description: Running Runs finished; each worker stops when its next renew is refused.

keysBlocked.description: False when a model key block is unconfirmed; the controller's block sweep retries it.

approved.description: True when approval queued the Work Item; false when rejection closed it as done (ADR-0031).

fromRound.description: The planned Round the new Shift starts at, counted from 1. Default 1.

poolUsd.description: The new Shift's pool. Default the Team plan's pool; at most the consumer's maxBudgetUsd.

note.description: Operator text added to every Run's briefing in the new Shift.

commandId.description: Idempotency key. A replay returns the first result.

expectedState.description: The state the caller saw. A mismatch answers 409 state_changed.

poolUsd.description: The pool authorized for the new Shift; 0 is unmetered.

shiftId.description: The Shift the requeue opened; null for a Team without Shifts.

previousShiftId.description: The item's most recent closed Shift, which stays closed with its close reason.

replayed.description: True when commandId repeated an earlier requeue and nothing changed.

settledAt.description: When the Run's gateway account was first settled. Absent before settlement and for a Run without an account.

costFinalAt.description: When the settled cost stops being corrected for late gateway charges: the end of the correction window, or settledAt when the settlement opened none.

costFinal.description: True once the Run's cost will no longer change. A settled cost before costFinalAt is provisional and may rise.

factsEpic.description: One tracker parent (epic or parent task) of the Work Item, as Ploeg last read it from work_item_epics. firstSeenAt is when Ploeg first saw the relation; removedAt is set when the tracker stopped reporting it, and a relation reported again starts over with a new firstSeenAt.

factsWithdrawal.description: One withdrawal of the Work Item recorded in the audit log.

actor.description: The audit actor as recorded: operator:<consumer>:<person> for an operator withdrawal, otherwise the tracker actor.

externalRef.description: The tracker reference used in commit trailers, or empty for manual work.

url.description: The tracker page, or empty when neither the tracker nor its link template gives one.

createdAt.description: When Ploeg first stored the Work Item.

trackerCreatedAt.description: When the tracker says the ticket was created; null until Ploeg read it.

estimateSeconds.description: The tracker's time estimate; null when the tracker keeps none or none was set.

externalScope.description: The tracker board or project the Work Item came from, as Ploeg stored it (work_items.external_scope); empty when the tracker gave none. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

admittedAt.description: When the Work Item was first queued or approved: the time of its first work_item.queued or work_item.approved audit entry. Null when it never was. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

factsLiveUsage.description: What the gateway recorded so far for one running Run, read when the facts were read (ADR-0049). A running Run without an entry could not be read.

factsPullRequestRef.description: One recorded pull request: Ploeg's id, the forge dialect, the repository and the number.

factsCommitStatus.description: The combined commit status Ploeg last read at headSha.

factsCIJob.description: One job of a CI run. startedAt, completedAt and queuedSeconds are absent when the forge did not report them.

factsCIRun.description: One CI run of the pull request (an Actions run, a pipeline or the statuses of one commit), replaced whole by each forge read. Job logs are never kept.

factsPullRequestEvent.description: Who did what on the pull request's conversation and when. No comment or review text is kept.

factsIndentation.description: The raw indentation measurements of one changed file, taken from the unified diff when the pull request merged. The diff itself is never stored.

unit.description: The spaces one indent level counts as in this file's diff; a tab is one level.

added.description: The sum of the indent levels of the non-blank added lines.

removed.description: The sum of the indent levels of the non-blank removed lines.

maxDepth.description: The deepest indent level of an added line.

factsFile.description: One file the merged pull request changed. A null line count is one the forge did not report; indentation is null when the diff was not measured.

factsChangedPaths.description: The paths the pull request changes at headSha, as the forge listed them while open. truncated is true when it changed more than Ploeg keeps.

factsRevert.description: A merged pull request that reverted this one. It need not be one of Ploeg's. matchedBy is title when its title began with Revert and named this number, and commit when one of its commits said it reverts this pull request's merge or head commit.

factsDeployment.description: The first reported deploy of one environment that carried the pull request's merge commit (ADR-0047).

factsPullRequest.description: One pull request opened for the Work Item, with every fact the forge reported and Ploeg stored. A null is a fact the forge has not reported, never a zero. Reviews, events, CI runs and deployments are oldest first.

url.description: The pull request link a Run or checkpoint reported, or empty when none named it.

firstSeenAt.description: When Ploeg first recorded the pull request.

labels.description: The label names the forge reported at merge; null when not read.

commits.description: Commits counted by the last activity read; a lower bound when activityTruncated.

forcePushes.description: Null on a forge that does not report force pushes.

factsStatusTransition.description: One move of the Work Item into another tracker status or bucket, in the order Ploeg recorded it.

gate.description: The delivery gate the status mapped to when Ploeg recorded the move, or null.

observed.description: True when the tracker did not say when the move happened, or said a time before the previous move, so at is when Ploeg received it.

factsGateTransition.description: One move of the Work Item into another delivery gate (ADR-0051), in the order Ploeg recorded it.

actor.description: The tracker user who made the move, or null when the tracker did not say.

reason.description: The bounce reason Ploeg found on the ticket when it recorded a move back to an earlier gate.

factsCheckpoint.description: A checkpoint a Run recorded with a pull request URL, oldest first (ADR-0079). Its createdAt can be earlier than the forge's opened time of that pull request.

factsRunBudgetHold.description: The budget one Run still holds, as Ploeg's budget accounting counts it (run_budget_holds): the authorized amount of a running Run without a gateway account, the larger of authorized and observed spend while its account is unsettled, and observed spend above the reconciled spend once reconciled. Listed only while above zero, including Runs outside a Shift.

factsDeployEnvironment.description: An environment the repository of one of the Work Item's pull requests has reported any deploy of, with its earliest reported deploy.

factsRosterEntry.description: A login the stored facts name, with what it did: merger merged a pull request, reviewer reviewed one, author opened one, pusher pushed or force-pushed, commenter commented on its conversation or diff, and mover moved the ticket between delivery gates. Ploeg's own forge logins are included; botLogins names them.

workItemFacts.description: The delivery facts of one Work Item (ADR-0079): what Ploeg stored about its Runs, pull requests, forge and tracker, with no derived figure. Runs and shifts use the same shapes as the Work Item detail; runs oldest first.

activityAt.description: The latest timestamp among the facts below, falling back to the Work Item's creation; the facts list orders by it.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoints that recorded a pull request URL, oldest first. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

runBudgetHolds.description: The Runs that still hold budget, by Run id. Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

botLogins.description: The forge logins Ploeg itself acts as, lowercased.

checkpoints.description: Optional: absent from older Ploeg releases.

image.description: An SVG Ploeg uploads as an attachment of the comment and shows above the markdown. Ploeg refuses one with scripts, event handlers, foreignObject, external references or entity declarations (422 unsafe_svg). On a forge that takes no attachment the comment carries the markdown alone.

number.description: The number of one of the Work Item's pull requests. Omitted = the newest one.

adoptCommentId.description: An existing comment on that pull request that carries a Ploeg marker, to take over instead of posting a new one.

commentId.description: The forge's comment id, null when the forge did not list the comment again after posting it.

imageUrl.description: The attachment URL the comment embeds: absolute on Forgejo, project-relative on GitLab. Null without an image or when the forge refused it.
